verdict.rationale: Proa is a code-first Rust web framework driven by a CLI and source code. It has no product UI or dashboard whose actions an API would need to mirror, so API/UI parity is the wrong axis for it. The "Proa UI" evidence covers vendored components for building apps, not an operator UI. A probe found an openapi.json on proa.so, but nothing in the pack says what it describes or that it mirrors any UI, so it does not make the axis apply.
